---
title: STOAT summary report on a fake binary phenotype
---

```{r include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8)
```

```{r}
library(StoatPlot)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

## path to association file (~stoat.assoc.pvalues.tsv.gz)
assoc_file = '../dwl_data/stoat.fake_binary.assoc.pvalues.tsv.gz'

## import association results
assoc = import_assoc(assoc_file)
```

## Summary

```{r, results='asis'}
sum.l = summary_stoat(assoc)
```

## QQ-plot

```{r qqplot, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
qq_plot(assoc)
```

## Manhattan plot

```{r manhplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=3}
manhattan_plot(assoc, show_top_points=1000)
```

Two-rows version

```{r manhplot_2rows, fig.height=6}
manhattan_plot(assoc, show_top_points=1000, wrap_by_rows=2)
```

## Top-associated variants

```{r}
assoc |> arrange(P) |> head(10)
```
